description: Represents a quoted, cited, or amended excerpt (text set off as a quotation of other text) as a single unit.
applicability: The page contains a BLOCK-LEVEL quoted passage, a citation, or an amendment that quotes/inserts other text, set off from the surrounding prose.
The excerpt is visually or grammatically distinct from the statement that introduces it.
This does NOT apply to inline quoted defined-terms or English glosses inside a definition — those stay part of their point, not a separate quote.
instructions: Keep the entire quoted excerpt together as one block; if it is introduced by a point, make it a child of that point.
Do not split the quotation into unrelated blocks, and do not merge it with the surrounding non-quoted text as if it were the same statement.
Preserve the quotation's own internal structure (if the quoted text itself contains numbering, keep that numbering verbatim inside the quote).
